One thing I really like about BoldDesk is that we can improve what happens behind the scenes without making things harder for the person asking for help.
Teams can continue using their existing support email addresses.
The email becomes a ticket behind the scenes, where it can be tracked, assigned, documented, and measured.
So for the customer, the experience can stay simple.
For the team, the process becomes much more organized.
And that creates an opportunity for better and faster communication without asking the person on the other end to learn an entirely new way of working.
